name: Bioenergy with CCS (BECCS)
aliases: bioenergy with carbon capture and storage
principle: CO2 from biomass combustion or fermentation is captured and stored, so net emissions are negative. Stockholm Exergi converts an existing biomass cogeneration plant using hot potassium carbonate capture, with liquefied CO2 shipped for permanent storage. The project avoids about seven million tonnes of CO2 over its first ten years; capture is targeted for late 2028 with EUR 180 million Innovation Fund support. IEA rates bioenergy with post-combustion capture at TRL 7.
